column1: # messages.tsv — the catalog of the messages Maat prints for a person (1.4.0): one entry per line, LF, UTF-8.
# Format: key<TAB>en<TAB>it. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored; a line without exactly two TABs too.
#   key   <script>.<name> (lowercase letters, digits, - and _; one dot at least), unique
#   en    English text (the default language); it: the Italian text ("lingua": "it" in .claude/maat.json)
#   both  non-empty, the same placeholders {name}; {{ and }} are literal braces; no other brace, no escape, no %
# Read by lib/maat-msg.sh (bash: msg) and maat_msg.py (Python: T), both next to this file; checked by messages.test.sh.
# A message on several lines is several entries. One section per script (block C and D lanes edit different sections).
# --- test entries (messages.test.sh): the only keys that no script uses

column2: attribution not measured ({gap}): the review would not know which files belong to the feature.
